stories.title: Flintshire residents warned over council tax credit scam email
stories.summary: Flintshire residents are being warned about a scam email claiming money has been credited to their council tax account. The county council’s Trading Standards team said the email tells people a credit has been recorded against their council tax file. stories.title: Collision on A494 eastbound near Queensferry leaves lane one blocked and long delays
stories.summary: A collision has blocked a lane of the A494 eastbound between Plough Lane and Queensferry during Tuesday morning’s rush hour. stories.title: Helen MacArthur appointed chief fire officer of North Wales Fire and Rescue Service
stories.summary: North Wales Fire and Rescue Service’s next chief fire officer will be a finance and governance specialist who joined the service eight years ago. stories.title: Risso’s dolphin put down in North Wales after public refloated it before medics arrived
stories.summary: A young Risso’s dolphin was put down on a beach at Penmaenmawr after members of the public dragged it back into the sea before marine medics could assess it.
